title: Sheinbaum Highlights PAN’s Distancing From Fox Over Remarks on the 2006 Fraud; How Interesting, Now They Don’t Want Him to Talk
author: Alma E. Muñoz and Arturo Sánchez
content:
_This article by Alma E. Muñoz and Arturo Sánchez originally appeared in
the[November 6, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/06/politica/sheinbaum-
resalta-el-deslinde-del-pan-de-fox-tras-dichos-sobre-el-fraude-en-2006-es-muy-
interesante-ahora-ya-no-quieren-que-hable), Mexico's premier left wing daily
newspaper._

**Mexico City**. In response to the distancing made by the president of the
PAN, Jorge Romero, from [Vicente Fox over his participation in the 2006
electoral
fraud](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/03/politica/sheinbaum-
califica-como-grave-intromision-de-fox-en-elecciones-de-2006-a-favor-de-
felipe-calderon), President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo asserted that **the
doctrine of the right is hypocrisy** , as Carlos Monsiváis said.

She noted that the distancing is "very interesting," after this PAN leadership
**" re-invited" Fox**, whose statement about those elections "is very
relevant," because:

> When we denounced the 2006 fraud, they treated us like we were crazy. Of
> course there was fraud.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum

At her press conference, she was ironic about the expression used by [Luis
Carlos
Ugalde](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/04/politica/sheinbaum-
senala-a-ugalde-de-ejecutar-en-2006-el-fraude-electoral-de-fox-para-imponer-a-
calderon), former president councilor of the then Federal Electoral Institute,
that Fox "should not talk anymore, please."

The President charged that the PAN member governed the country "as if it were
a business" and now "we find out from Vicente Fox himself that yes, yes, he
did commit electoral fraud, that he participated, that **he never would have
handed the presidential sash to (Andrés Manuel) López Obrador**." It is very
interesting, she pointed out, that "now the PAN says: oh, no, no more Fox, the
one we brought in to help us with the next election; no, better we distance
ourselves from him because he talks too much."
